title: Establishment of CERN
description: Twelve European countries ratify the CERN convention, establishing the European Organization for Nuclear Research near Geneva to foster peaceful fundamental science.

title: Proton Synchrotron (PS) Commissioning
description: The PS accelerates protons to 24 GeV for the first time, briefly becoming the highest-energy particle accelerator in the world. It remains active today as the heart of the injector chain.

title: Intersecting Storage Rings (ISR)
description: World's first hadron collider begins operation, demonstrating that colliding counter-rotating beams achieves far higher center-of-mass energy than fixed-target accelerators.

title: Discovery of Neutral Currents (Gargamelle)
description: The Gargamelle heavy-liquid bubble chamber discovers weak neutral current neutrino interactions, confirming electroweak unification by Glashow, Salam, and Weinberg.

title: Discovery of W and Z Bosons
description: Experiments UA1 and UA2 at the converted SPS proton-antiproton collider discover the W+, W-, and Z0 intermediate vector bosons, leading to the 1984 Nobel Prize in Physics for Carlo Rubbia and Simon van der Meer.

title: Invention of the World Wide Web
description: Tim Berners-Lee submits 'Information Management: A Proposal' at CERN, creating the hypertext protocols (HTTP, HTML, URI) and first web server (info.cern.ch) to share particle physics data globally.

title: Large Electron-Positron Collider (LEP)
description: The 27 km LEP tunnel begins operation, conducting high-precision electroweak tests at the Z pole (91.2 GeV) and W-pair threshold (209 GeV), proving there are exactly three generations of light neutrinos.

title: LHC First Beam
description: Proton beams circulate around the 27 km superconducting LHC ring for the first time, cooled by 96 tonnes of superfluid liquid helium to 1.9 Kelvin.

title: Discovery of the Higgs Boson
description: ATLAS and CMS announce the observation of a new neutral scalar boson at 125.3 GeV with 5 sigma significance, completing the Standard Model of particle physics.

title: LHC Run 3 Startup at 13.6 TeV
description: Following Long Shutdown 2 and injector upgrades (Linac4 commissioning), the LHC resumes physics operation at a record center-of-mass energy of 13.6 TeV.

title: High-Luminosity LHC (HL-LHC) Era
description: Commissioning of HL-LHC target luminosity (5-7.5 x 10^34 cm^-2 s^-1) aiming to amass 3000 fb^-1 to measure rare Higgs decay branching fractions to sub-percent precision.
